title: Buff bar: icons with timers, hover names, right-click to cancel
player_outcome: Active buffs show as rows of 32 px icons under the hotbar, with timers like '4 m' or '30 s'. Placed-furniture buffs show no timer, and icons blink before expiring. With the inventory open, hovering shows the name and effect, and right-clicking removes a buff, but never a debuff.
design: Core: `BuffSet.TryCancel(string id)` returns false when !BuffDisplay.CanCancel(def), otherwise removes the buff and raises Changed. The caller then calls PlayerState.Recompute.
New game/UI/Hud/BuffBar.cs: an HFlowContainer in the Buffs rect holding pooled BuffIconView nodes (up to 44). It rebinds only when BuffSet.Changed fires or the count changes.

New game/UI/Hud/BuffIconView.cs (Control, 32×46):
- Draws StatusIcons.Get(def) at 32 px.
- The timer below uses Core BuffDisplay.Timer, is hidden when !ShowsTimer, and its text is rebuilt only when the whole number of seconds changes.
- In the last 5 s the alpha pulses.
- MouseFilter is Stop only while the mouse is free (InputGate.MouseFree), so it never eats clicks during play.
- Hover shows TooltipFollower text: name, plus Description or BuffText.Describe.
- Right-click calls TryCancel, Recompute and the ui_click sound.
Remove Hud.UpdateBuffs (Hud.cs:249-267), which re-applied a colour override to every label every frame.
UiCommands gains `ui buff cancel <id>`, which goes through the same view handler. UiProbes gains `hud.buffs`.
files_modify: game/UI/Hud.cs — BuffBar in place of the chip row
tests: BuffCancelTests: CancelRemovesBuffAndRecomputes (ironskin: defense returns to base); DebuffsAndPersistentBuffsCannotBeCancelled

ui.cmds:
- `give swiftness_potion 1` / `wield swiftness_potion` / `use` / `wait 0.3` / `assert buff.swiftness == 1` / `assert hud.buffs >= 1`.
- `ui buff cancel swiftness` / `assert buff.swiftness == 0`.
- `give lesser_healing_potion 1` / `wield lesser_healing_potion` / `use` / `wait 0.3` / `ui buff cancel potion_sickness` / `assert buff.potion_sickness == 1`.
verification: Lavapipe screenshot with 3 potions active: icons under the hotbar, timers readable, nothing over the FPS or info text
risks: The status-visual buffs from the feel phase (flames on the player) are separate; this WP only touches the HUD.
